title: Numerical integration and trustworthy checks
rows: \(h=(b-a)/n,\quad x_i=a+ih\). Positive integer n panels; n+1 endpoints.
Forward bounds. Increasing: \(L_n\leq I\leq R_n\); decreasing: reversed. Width \(h|f(b)-f(a)|\). T error at most half-width.
\(T=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(x_{i+1}-x_i)(y_i+y_{i+1})/2\). Coordinates increasing; use actual widths and consistent units.
Midpoint/trapezoid exact for linear f. Reverse bounds: M,T change sign. \(L_n(b,a)=-R_n(a,b)\).
If \(Q_n-I\approx C/n^2\), finer error \(\approx|Q_{2n}-Q_n|/3\). Estimate, not a bound; inspect features and successive differences.
Absolute: \(|Q-I|\). Relative: \(|Q-I|/|I|\), only \(I\ne0\); use absolute tolerance near cancellation.
Domain, units, hand sum, exact benchmark, refinement, sample positions; split known changes using one-sided piece formulas.
Interpolated rows add no observations. Shared bias and missed features survive refinement. Retain precision until display.
Finite continuous or piecewise-continuous models on bounded intervals; inspect domains and split known changes.
